description:
A 999-year-old Imugi, one year away from ascending to heaven, is unjustly killed and wakes up to find himself transformed into a one-year-old hatchling. His second life begins with him retaining all his past memories. He gradually, and completely, melts into the unconditional love he is receiving for the first time. Amidst love and the expansion of his horizons, the second life of the hatchling "Rune" begins as he marches toward becoming a dragon, a goal he could not achieve in his previous life!


[Original Novel](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=8427784)
